query: CRISPR Cas9 gene editing off-target effects

results.title: High-throughput mapping of CRISPR-Cas9 off-target effects in human cells
results.abstract: We profile genome-wide off-target cleavage induced by Cas9 ribonucleoprotein delivery in primary human cells. Using GUIDE-seq and targeted amplicon sequencing, we quantify editing at predicted and cryptic sites and propose design heuristics that reduce off-target activity without sacrificing on-target efficiency.

results.title: Machine learning prediction of CRISPR off-target sites from chromatin context
results.abstract: A gradient-boosted model trained on chromatin accessibility and mismatch topology improves off-target ranking compared to naive seed-match rules in cell-line benchmarks.
